curators.name: Spotify editorial playlists
curators.guidelines: In Spotify for Artists go to Music → Upcoming and pitch one unreleased song. Pitch at least 7 days before release so it lands in your followers' Release Radar; 3–4 weeks ahead gives editors more time. Fill in every field (genre, mood, instruments, story). Songs you're only featured on can't be pitched.
curators.free_note: Pitching is free. No one can pay to be added to Spotify's editorial playlists.

curators.name: Amazon Music editors
curators.guidelines: In the Amazon Music for Artists app: Profile & Tools → New Releases. One track per release, from a verified artist profile. Pitches are accepted until 14 days after street date, but pitch before release for release-week playlists. Mention your marketing plans, hometown fan base, features and videos.
curators.free_note: Pitching is part of the free Amazon Music for Artists app.

curators.name: Pandora AMP Featured Tracks
curators.guidelines: Claim your artist profile in Pandora AMP (your distributor gets the music onto Pandora). A Featured Track gets extra spins on more stations for up to 8 weeks. 6 per calendar year, one at a time, and the track needs at least 10 radio spins that week to qualify.
curators.free_note: Featured Tracks is a completely free AMP tool.

curators.name: Audiomack editorial & Trending
curators.guidelines: Upload to Audiomack and authenticate your creator account to unlock the Trending and playlist submission tools in the Creator app. Use full genre tags, tag your city, and write a real description of the song.
curators.free_note: Playlist pitching is one of Audiomack's free creator tools; no subscription needed.

curators.name: TIDAL Upload & Spotlight
curators.guidelines: Upload an original track to TIDAL Upload and keep it public; that enters it for TIDAL Spotlight editorial consideration (picks get a one-time $1,000 award). 18+, in the US, Canada, UK, Switzerland or EEA.
curators.free_note: TIDAL Upload is free for artists, and Spotlight has no separate application.

curators.name: Bandcamp Daily
curators.guidelines: Use the submission form in Bandcamp's Artist Guide; it goes to an editor. Send your Bandcamp link (a draft or private release is fine) and the angle that makes the record interesting. Eight weeks before release is ideal. They get about 1,000 pitches a week.
curators.free_note: Free submission form straight to Bandcamp Daily editors.

curators.name: Pigeons & Planes
curators.guidelines: Direct-from-artist submissions only. For playlist consideration they've also asked for email to submissions@pigeonsandplanes.com with the subject "PLAYLIST SUBMISSION" and a Spotify link. They publish best-new-artists lists and an annual Artists to Watch.
curators.free_note: Open submissions page; no fee.

curators.name: Underground Hip Hop Blog
curators.guidelines: Include artist name, location, a link with embed code (YouTube, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, Audiomack or Spotify), a short description, artwork, social links and any press links. No MP3 attachments. Hundreds of submissions a day.
curators.free_note: Email submissions; no fee or paid option listed.

curators.name: Hip Hop Golden Age
curators.guidelines: Classic hip-hop platform that also posts new music. Best fit if your sound leans boom bap or golden-era.
curators.free_note: Dedicated music submissions address; no fee listed.

curators.name: The Word Is Bond
curators.guidelines: The submissions email is on the guideline page. Subject must be "Music Submission: Artist Name : Song Name". Include a short bio, 960px+ artwork, and all your socials. Picks go into their weekly Top Submissions playlists.
curators.free_note: Email submissions by guideline; no paid option listed.

curators.name: Soundplate hip-hop playlists
curators.guidelines: Pick a hip-hop, rap, trap, UK hip-hop or lofi playlist that already plays music like yours, click Submit Music and sign in with Spotify. Released tracks only. Send one track at a time, your best one.
curators.free_note: Totally free for artists.

curators.name: PlaylistDock
curators.guidelines: Submit directly to independent Spotify curators. No account needed. Up to 3 free submissions a day, so pick the closest-fitting hip-hop playlists.
curators.free_note: No fees, no premium tier, no credits to buy.

curators.name: PlaylistPartner
curators.guidelines: No signup. Paste your Spotify track link and choose from 1,300+ hip-hop playlists (boom bap, trap, melodic rap, drill, conscious). Up to 10 playlists a day.
curators.free_note: No fees, subscriptions, hidden costs or premium features.

curators.name: Lofi Girl
curators.guidelines: Lofi hip-hop and chill beats only. Must be 100% human-made (no AI). Submitting grants Lofi Records a non-exclusive licence to showcase your submission on their channels.
curators.free_note: Artist's Form submission; no fee.

curators.name: BBC Introducing (Radio 1Xtra and local BBC)
curators.guidelines: UK artists only. Make an Introducing artist account, tag your genre and postcode, and upload through the Uploader; your local BBC team hears it and can pass it to Radio 1, 1Xtra and others. Limit: 2 tracks every 30 days.
curators.free_note: Free for unsigned and self-releasing artists; the Uploader is the only official route.

curators.name: triple j Unearthed
curators.guidelines: Australian citizens or residents, not signed to a major. Make an ABC account and artist profile, then Manage Tracks → upload (WAV/MP3/AAC/OGG, 100 MB max). The team listens in full; approval takes up to 10 business days.
curators.free_note: Free to upload original music.

curators.name: KEXP 90.3 (Seattle)
curators.guidelines: Send streaming and download (WAV) links, no attachments. Specialty-show DJs, including hip-hop, list their own addresses on kexp.org. They rarely reply about status.
curators.free_note: Digital submissions to the music director; no fee.

curators.name: KCRW 89.9 (Los Angeles)
curators.guidelines: Submit an FCC-clean .wav or .aiff. KCRW's DJs listen to what comes in.
curators.free_note: Music suggestions by email; no fee.

curators.name: Find, Share, Rewind (DJ Shadow, KCRW)
curators.guidelines: DJ Shadow's KCRW show. Email music for consideration; send something with character that fits a crate-digger's set.
curators.free_note: Show submissions by email; no fee.

curators.name: WNYU 89.1 (New York)
curators.guidelines: Digital submissions go to the Music Director. They prioritize physical (CD or vinyl) if you have it.
curators.free_note: Digital submissions by email; no fee.

curators.name: Equilibrium (WHCR 90.3, Harlem)
curators.guidelines: Hip-hop show hosted by Kwame Vear and Priest Forever, Mondays 10pm–midnight. Email an MP3, then follow up with the host by email.
curators.free_note: Email the show directly; no fee.

curators.name: Hip Hop Hall of Fame (WHCR 90.3, Harlem)
curators.guidelines: One-hour show on hip-hop music, culture and history, hosted by JT Thompson. Email an MP3.
curators.free_note: Email the show directly; no fee.

curators.name: The New Life Music Mix (WHCR 90.3, Harlem)
curators.guidelines: Christian hip-hop show hosted by DJ G. Email an MP3.
curators.free_note: Email the show directly; no fee.

curators.name: Undaground Railroad (WVFS V89, Tallahassee)
curators.guidelines: WVFS's hip-hop program. Send streaming and download links, no attachments.
curators.free_note: Program submissions by email; no fee.

curators.name: WVFS V89 (Tallahassee)
curators.guidelines: Streaming and download links, no attachments. Album-oriented station: EPs and albums have a much better shot at rotation than singles.
curators.free_note: Digital submissions by email; no fee.

curators.name: KCR College Radio (San Diego State)
curators.guidelines: Digital submissions only. Especially keen on San Diego artists. Accepted tracks go into the automated playlist between live shows. Don't call to check status.
curators.free_note: All musicians encouraged to submit by email; no fee.

curators.name: WREK 91.1 (Atlanta)
curators.guidelines: Georgia Tech's student station. Email the music director; the same address answers status questions.
curators.free_note: Email submissions to the music director; no fee.

curators.name: WXYC 89.3 (Chapel Hill)
curators.guidelines: Freeform UNC student station. The music submissions address is on the contact page.
curators.free_note: Email submissions to the music department; no fee.

curators.name: NPR Tiny Desk Contest
curators.guidelines: Film yourself performing one original song behind a desk, upload it to YouTube, and fill in the entry form. US residents, 18+. Opens each January; the 2026 window closed Feb 9.
curators.free_note: No purchase or payment of any kind is necessary to enter or win.
